description_en: Creates a time-limited static access token for a specified user in the current account to access a single cloud desktop
description_zh: 为当前账号下的指定用户创建访问单台云电脑的有限期静态访问令牌
name: CreateThirdAppAccessToken

parameters.help_en: The WyId of the authorized user. The user must belong to the current calling account. This parameter is not the username
parameters.help_zh: 授权用户的 WyId。用户必须属于当前调用账号。该参数不是用户名
parameters.name: authorizer_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the target cloud desktop. You must provide a non-empty value when you call this operation. Asterisks (*) are not allowed. The cloud desktop must be authorized to the user specified by AuthorizerId
fields.help_zh: 目标云电脑 ID。调用时必须提供非空值，不能使用星号（*）。该云电脑必须已授权给 AuthorizerId 指定的用户
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The resource type. This parameter is required when you call this operation. Set the value to DESKTOP, which indicates a cloud desktop. The value is case-insensitive
fields.help_zh: 资源类型。调用时必须提供，取值为 DESKTOP，表示云电脑；取值忽略大小写
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The target single cloud desktop resource. You must provide this object along with ResourceType and ResourceId when you call this operation. Pass this parameter as a JSON object and specify only one cloud desktop. Wildcards or authorization for all cloud desktops are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 目标单台云电脑资源。调用时必须提供此对象及 ResourceType、ResourceId。以 JSON 对象传入，仅指定一台云电脑；不支持通配符或全部云电脑授权
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The business channel. Valid values: Enterprise and Business. The value is case-insensitive. If omitted, the default value is Enterprise. If an empty string or other values are explicitly passed, a parameter error is returned. This parameter does not replace user identity verification
parameters.help_zh: 业务渠道。取值：Enterprise（企业版）或 Business（商业版），忽略大小写。省略时默认为 Enterprise；显式传入空字符串或其他值时返回参数错误。该参数不替代用户身份校验
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the token, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15552000. If omitted, the default value is 15552000, which equals 180 days. Permanent validity is not supported, and 0 cannot be passed
parameters.help_zh: 令牌有效时长，单位为秒。取值范围：1～15552000。省略时默认为 15552000（180 天）；不支持永久有效，不能传入 0
parameters.name: expiration

schema.description_en: The access token and expiration information returned when the call is successful
schema.description_zh: 调用成功时返回的访问令牌及到期信息

AccessToken.description_en: The time-limited static access token created for the specified user and single cloud desktop. This is a sensitive credential. Do not log or expose the full value
AccessToken.description_zh: 为指定用户和单台云电脑创建的有限期静态访问令牌。属于敏感凭证，请勿记录或公开完整值

ExpiresAt.description_en: The absolute expiration time of the token, in UNIX milliseconds. This parameter is not empty when the call is successful. GetLatestThirdAppAccessToken returns the original expiration time without extending it
ExpiresAt.description_zh: 令牌绝对到期时间，采用 Unix 毫秒时间戳。调用成功时非空；GetLatestThirdAppAccessToken 返回原到期时间，不续期
ExpiresAt.title_en: Token绝对截止时间，Unix毫秒；成功时非空，查询不续期
ExpiresAt.title_zh: Token绝对截止时间，Unix毫秒；成功时非空，查询不续期

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位和排查问题
